com.vector.cfg.dom.runtimesys.api.assistant.connection

Interface ITargetComponentPort

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IComponentPort, IHasModelObject, IModelAbstraction

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface ITargetComponentPort
extends IComponentPort
    ITargetComponentPort is a specialization of IComponentPort and represents a potential target component port for a connection.

    A target port comprises of

  • a compatibility index for the connection to a source component port.
  • an optional port interface mapping which will be used when connecting the component port to a source component port.
